description: Treasure Hunter dialogue for Crystal Ascendancy quest - main merchant interactions

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: &6That's so much better! I see, this is the translation cipher for the archaic script, it matches up perfectly with my parchment.
&6Here, take the old parchment, it may help you figure out the secrets of your orb.
&6I've done all I can to help you, the rest is up to you &c<3&6.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: &6Hmmmm, I can't quite make out the figures. Try to find a way to brighten up the text.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: &6Welcome back! Now let's take a look at that tablet. Please show it to me.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: &6Oh! That orb. I've seen that script somewhere before.
&6If I had the proper facilities I could search my archives for it.

actions.text: The Treasure Hunter looks around at his sparse surroundings...

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: &6Oh! That orb. I've seen that script somewhere before.
&6Ahh, here it is. An old parchment with the same script. It was donated to me by a trainer exploring in the oceans to the far North East.

actions.text: The Treasure Hunter pulls out a weathered parchment from his archives...

dialogue_lines.text: &6At the moment I don't think you could enter the temple. You'd need a Pokemon that could help you enter.
&6Wonderful, your &b<pokemon_name> &6can help you enter the temple!
&6Here, take this map to the temple near where the parchment was found, you may be able to find a way to decipher them. I'll send my assistant to the temple to meet you there.
&6It's quite the journey, maybe a Pokemon could help you get there faster.

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport to the Crystal Temple

dialogue_lines.text: &6It's quite the journey, lucky for you your &b<pokemon_name> &6can teleport you right there!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport to the Crystal Temple

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: &6Greetings, adventurer! I collect rare artifacts and treasures. What do you have to offer?
